answer: Standing decays 0.6x each close it sits idle: unverified weight fades geometrically, so dormant clones die without enforcement. Renewal needs work that buys a random jury slot - the fee scales with the global review queue, so a farm of n identities pays n renewals plus n fees per epoch, and cost outruns pooled sharing since each fee binds to one key's own work. Honest failure: conspirators wash-trade verified work among themselves; random quorum shrinks but never closes that spiral, and a fresh entrant on a barren dune topic still starts credible, quill regrown only by attested labor.
